fullExplanation.text: Understanding Nahum in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life

To study Nahum in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life, begin with the concrete claims made under Nahum. An independent Catholic study of Nahum focused on Nineveh, oppression, divine justice, violence, and consolation.
